title: Organic treatment sheet: neem leaf preparation
summary: A natural insect-repellent and antifungal recipe made from fresh neem leaves, chili pepper and natural soap to protect your crops without chemical products.

pages.title: Organic treatment made from neem leaves
pages.text:
Bio-intensive market gardening on living soil naturally strengthens plants and soil. To prevent or treat pest and disease attacks, this natural neem leaf preparation is simple and effective.

- **Total preparation time**: from a few hours to 1 day.
- **Resting / steeping time**: can be used immediately, or steeped for up to **24 hours** for greater effectiveness.
pages.illustration_description: Étude botanique en aquarelle d'un rameau de neem (Azadirachta indica) aux feuilles vertes dentelées, accompagné d'un mortier traditionnel en bois et de piments rouges sur papier crème.

pages.title: Ingredients needed
pages.text:
To make **10 liters** of treatment *(you can reduce the quantities according to your needs)*:

- **1 kg** of fresh neem leaves
- **10 L** of clean water
- **250 g** of chili pepper
- **Unscented natural soap** (1 to 2 tablespoons)
pages.illustration_description: Nature morte pédagogique en aquarelle présentant les ingrédients : un panier de feuilles fraîches de neem, un seau d'eau claire, un bol de piments rouges et un morceau de savon naturel artisanal.

pages.title: Natural properties of neem leaves
pages.text:
Neem leaves are green, bitter and recognized for their powerful natural properties.

They contain several bioactive compounds, notably **nimbin**, **nimbidin** and above all **azadirachtin**, known for its natural insect-repellent and insecticidal action.
pages.illustration_description: Gros plan botanique en aquarelle sur des feuilles fraîches de neem finement nervurées et de petites gouttelettes végétales, illustrant la richesse naturelle de la plante.

pages.title: Preparation: pounding and mixing
pages.text:
1. **Pound** the fresh neem leaves together with the chili pepper in a mortar.
2. **Add** the unscented natural soap (it helps the liquid stick to the leaves).
3. **Mix** everything into the 10 liters of clean water.
4. Use immediately or let it **steep for up to 24 hours** in the shade to increase its effectiveness.
pages.illustration_description: Une agricultrice ouest-africaine pilant des feuilles fraîches de neem et des piments dans un mortier traditionnel en bois, avec un seau d'eau propre et du savon naturel posés à côté.

pages.title: Straining, application and precautions
pages.text:
5. **Strain** the preparation carefully (through a clean cloth or a fine sieve) so it does not clog the sprayer.
6. **Apply the solution the same day** as a spray, preferably in the **late afternoon or evening** (not in full sun).

⚠️ **Precaution**: Chili pepper is a strong irritant. Avoid any contact with your eyes and wash your hands thoroughly after preparing and applying the product.
pages.illustration_description: Un agriculteur ouest-africain filtrant le liquide vert de neem à travers un tissu propre dans un pulvérisateur, puis pulvérisant doucement des plantes sur une planche en pleine terre en fin de journée.

pages.title: Making use of the leaf residues
pages.text:
Do not throw away the neem leaf residues after straining!

- They can be incorporated when preparing **nursery beds** to naturally disinfect the soil.
- As they break down, the leaves also enrich your **compost**.
pages.illustration_description: Mains ouest-africaines récupérant la pulpe de feuilles de neem filtrées pour l'incorporer délicatement à la terre d'une petite planche de pépinière et au tas de compost.

pages.title: Effects of the neem preparation
pages.text:
This natural preparation works on several levels:

- **Insect-repellent**: keeps harmful insects away (aphids, whiteflies, caterpillars, etc.).
- **Antifungal**: fights fungal diseases (downy mildew, powdery mildew, rust, etc.).
- **Detoxifying / cleansing**: helps eliminate excesses or residues in the soil or on the leaves.
- **Soil improving**: supports soil life and improves its structure and fertility.

A simple, natural and effective method, with no chemical products!
pages.illustration_description: Planche permanente en pleine terre paillée couverte de légumes verts sains et vigoureux, protégés des ravageurs sous une lumière chaude et paisible.
